# PRIV-001 Client Data Privacy Policy

> Fictional document for demonstration. Not a real policy.

## 1. Purpose

Explains what client data Acme collects, why, how long it is kept, and with whom it is shared.

## 2. Definitions

- **Client Data**: any information relating to an identified or identifiable client.
- **Processor**: a vendor that handles Client Data on Acme's behalf.

## 3. Collection

Acme collects only the data required for onboarding (POL-006 §3), trading, settlement, regulatory reporting and client service.

## 4. Consent and purpose

Client Data shall be used only for the purposes disclosed at onboarding. Marketing use requires separate opt-in consent.

## 5. Sharing

| Recipient | Basis |
|---|---|
| Exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories, SEBI | Regulatory obligation |
| Processors under written contract | Service delivery |
| Any other party | Client consent or legal order only |

## 6. Retention schedule

| Record | Retention |
|---|---|
| KYC records | 5 years after account closure |
| Order and trade logs | 5 years |
| Call recordings | 3 years |
| Complaint records | 5 years |

## 7. Security

Client Data shall be encrypted in transit and at rest; access is role-based and logged.

## 8. Rights

Clients may request access to or correction of their data; requests are handled within 30 days.

## 9. Review

Annual review by the CCO.
